implemented_components.compiler: Compiles already-materialized accepted IR to parameterized SQLite write programs.
implemented_components.completeness: Requires every Phase O semantic slot to be mapped exactly once.
implemented_components.inventories: Builds model-side schema inventories and rejects gold-side leakage keys.
implemented_components.json_schema: Validates the frozen Draft 2020-12 schema subset needed by Phase O and dynamic Phase M schemas without adding runtime dependencies.
implemented_components.phase_m_schema_and_output: Instantiates real operation-specific Draft 2020-12 schemas with dynamic enums and enforces SLOT/EVIDENCE coherence.
implemented_components.phase_o_schema_and_output: Validates against frozen Phase O JSON Schema, parses operation plus value-span offsets, and forbids span_ref/text emission.
implemented_components.pipeline: Orchestrates the V2-A1 state machine with injected mocked Phase O/M outputs only.
implemented_components.preflight: Runs SQLite execution checks on a copied DB with rollback and a wall-clock progress-handler deadline.
implemented_components.prompt_rendering: Renders exact frozen Stage7C-A1 role/content messages and exposes the tokenizer.apply_chat_template contract adapter.
implemented_components.protocol: Loads locked Stage7B, Stage7B-A1, Stage7C-A1, and Stage7D protocols and fail-fast verifies upstream input hashes.
implemented_components.slot_inventory: Derives deterministic SPAN/EV/SLOT IDs after sorted accepted offsets.
implemented_components.span_validation: Validates Python Unicode code-point [start,end) offsets and rejects duplicate/overlapping spans.
implemented_components.typed_materializer: Applies conservative SQLite-affinity materialization without implicit date/unit normalization.
